- Original maturity date (November 1, 2024)
- Extended maturity date (November 1, 2025) 
- Extension effective date (October 31, 2020)
- Facility type (Revolving Credit Facility)
- Borrower name (First Huntingdon Finance Corp.)
- Administrative Agent (Citibank, N.A.)
- All participating lender names
- Key dates (Extension Request date of September 30, 2020, response deadline of October 23, 2020)

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for terms like deal size, interest rate, and covenant details because these are not specified in the extension request document itself. The source document is specifically an extension request, not the full credit agreement, so it doesn't contain the underlying financial terms like loan amounts, pricing, or covenant details. The memo correctly identifies this limitation in its note at the bottom.
